steps.title: Add water to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the required volume of water into each well of the plate.

steps.instruction: Add the barcode reagent to each well of the plate as specified.

steps.title: Add DNA to plate
steps.instruction: Add the DNA sample to each well of the plate.

steps.instruction: Combine the samples according to the specified well layout.

Pool samples into the first two wells.
Pool samples into the first well.

steps.instruction: Perform bead‑based purification of the pooled samples.
